LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why are some things impossible to count? 2. How can you group things that cannot be counted?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: A learner create posters and poems, and share them on the classroom wall or through

digital learning platforms. This enhances teamwork among the learners.

Values:
● Unity: A learner work together to identify the different types of nouns in the classroom.

● Respect: A learner take turns to work in groups to create poems and posters.

Link to other subjects:

● Kiswahili, German, and Arabic focus on count and non-count nouns, as well as singular and plural nouns.

● Health Education addresses health issues such as HIV and AIDS.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Braille reading materials,

● braille machines,

● audio recording,

● crossword puzzles,

● newspaper,

● digital devices
